description: We automate the most time-consuming workflows of the world's greatest sales teams
problem_statement: Sellers spend only 28% of their week selling and spend 72% of their week on manual work that slows deals. We're building Cyrus as the autonomous teammate that handles that work so sellers can sell 3x more

team.justification: The founding team has strong domain expertise and a proven track record in sales and operations, evidenced by their previous roles at Vendr and other tech companies. They have complementary skills in engineering, product, and go-to-market strategies.

company_assessment.business_model_strength: The business model leverages both PLG and enterprise sales, with a clear pricing strategy of $1200/user/year. The model is scalable and targets a large market with significant pain points.
company_assessment.market_positioning: Cyrus AI positions itself as an autonomous teammate for sales teams, differentiating from competitors by focusing on automating manual tasks rather than just providing insights.
company_assessment.execution_capability: The team has demonstrated execution capability by developing a product and securing design partners, including notable companies like Ramp.
company_assessment.strategic_vision: The leadership has a clear vision to capture and educate the market before it becomes saturated, leveraging their networks for traction.

founder_deep_dive.name: Ali Zolfaghari
founder_deep_dive.background: Ali has a strong background in sales and operations, having been a top performer at Vendr and co-founding a GTM consulting company.
founder_deep_dive.domain_expertise: Expertise in B2B sales processes and operations.
founder_deep_dive.notable_achievements: Top performer at Vendr, advisor roles at Ramp and other tech companies.
founder_deep_dive.leadership_signals: Demonstrated leadership in building and scaling sales operations.

track_record.outcome: Contributed to company growth and success.
track_record.learnings: Gained insights into sales processes and operations.

competitive_analysis.landscape_overview: The competitive landscape includes companies like Rox, Jeeva.ai, Reevo.ai, and Artisan AI, each focusing on different aspects of sales automation.
competitive_analysis.competitor_comparison: Cyrus AI differentiates by focusing on automating manual tasks rather than just providing insights or data enrichment.
competitive_analysis.positioning_assessment: Cyrus AI's focus on being an autonomous teammate provides a unique value proposition that sets it apart from competitors.

red_flags: Limited founding experience and lack of venture capital network.

tam.justification: The total addressable market is substantial at $112B, with clear pain points and a large potential customer base in B2B SaaS sales.

market_analysis.total_addressable_market: $112B TAM, supported by the widespread need for sales process automation.
market_analysis.serviceable_addressable_market: Significant portion of the TAM is serviceable given the broad applicability of the solution.

market_analysis.market_dynamics: Key trends include the shift towards automation and AI in sales processes.
